title: Cardinal Billing Account Renewal Down Payment: Tenure Reduction for Long-Standing Policies
content:
**Clause.** A tenure reduction is subtracted from the renewal down payment percentage of a Cardinal Billing Account: **5 percentage points** when the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy's original inception date is at least 96 whole months before the bill date, **2.5 percentage points** when it is at least 60 but under 96 whole months before, and none otherwise.

The original inception date is the date shown on the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy as the start of the policy with Cardinal; tenure is counted in whole months from that date to the bill date (the renewal bill date). The reduction is in percentage points of the percentage, not a percent of it.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Whole months from inception to the bill date | Tenure reduction |
|---|---|
| 120 | 5 percentage points |
| 96 | 5 percentage points |
| 95 | 2.5 percentage points |
| 60 | 2.5 percentage points |
| 59 | None |

**Hypothetical figure.** A renewal down payment percentage of 25 percent on a policy incepted 100 whole months before the bill date becomes 20 percent after the reduction of 5 percentage points; at 70 whole months it becomes 22.5 percent.
